skill_name: What are the strategies to effectively use digital marketing?
workflow: There are many strategies that can be used to effectively use digital marketing. Some of these strategies include creating engaging content, optimizing for search engines, using social media, leveraging email marketing, measuring performance, and leveraging influencers. Creating engaging content ensures that your target audience finds it interesting and shareable. Optimizing for search engines allows you to be found more easily on the web.
